summary: Round 4 (final pass before 5): verified TEST-002 and TEST-003's fixes hands-on, plus five user-visible changes from review rounds 06/07 (36 findings total, 28 verified + 7 fixed + REV-024 deliberately deferred to phase 5). Baseline re-verified independently: all four gates green, gogo --version 0.29.0. Item 1: built both previously-lying moveChip shapes (in-progress+awaiting-plan-acceptance advertised 'not runnable' but m legally accepts; in-progress+plan-accepted-with-unwritten-plan advertised '[m] go' but FR8 bounces) - both now show the correct chip and both m presses do exactly what the chip promises. Item 2: a plain decision (D1) names decisions.md; the explicit false-positive shape (open-decision containing the literal substring 'uat' but not a real UAT round) correctly still names decisions.md, not uat.md; a genuine UAT round names uat.md and agrees with its own re-planning pill - the digit-after-uat discriminator (isUATReplan) holds. Item 3: a legitimate ready-card selection survives an ordinary reload; after truncating state.md mid-write the selection is dropped (reproducing REV-035's exact scenario, unchanged from what review described); after restoring the full file the card returns to ready UNSELECTED, not resurrected. Judgment given as asked: the drop is not worse than the resurrect it replaced - it is the safer, principle-consistent direction (degrade to missing, never to wrong; bounded, recoverable harm vs. an unattended-looking ship of an unintended card) - not escalated as a new issue. Item 4: aborted/shipped/done/empty-status all read truthfully on both the board and headless gogo go, with no contradiction between the two surfaces (only a specificity difference on the empty-status case). Item 5: re-swept all six round-01 scenarios (authoring gate, FR4a, FR8 headless, the cap hole, the targeted-sweep remedy, TEST-001's chip absence at 400 columns) - no regressions, despite move.go/view.go/model.go all being touched again this round. No hands-on check was blocked; host safety intact throughout (protected sessions verified unchanged before and after, no bare gogo sweep run). TEST-001/TEST-002/TEST-003 all verified; 0 open/new issues.
